intent: Survive five connected storm arenas: first rain, moving terraces, a fleeing causeway, crosswinds and the final squall. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The first squall
sections.lesson: Read the amber warning · dodge the falling seeds. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:

The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: The wind-tossed terraces
sections.lesson: Keep moving between the terraces. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: Run with the storm
